name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing updates across multiple supported branches simultaneously. The latest stable release is v0.62.1 (Open Source) / v1.62.1 (Enterprise), released on June 8, 2025, with patch releases also pushed for branches 61.x, 60.x, 58.x, and 57.x on the same date. A beta for v0.62.0 was published on June 3, 2025. Detailed per-release changelogs are linked from each GitHub release page at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases. Both Docker images and JAR downloads are available for each edition.

answers.What is the current license?: Dual-license: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several major branches were published on June 8, 2025.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported as Enterprise/Pro features.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Druid, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, Athena, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualizations and enterprise features but is expensive, closed-source, and requires significant licensing costs.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-first workflow but has a smaller ecosystem and fewer data source connectors than Metabase.
